text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was on a day when we were carrying out training for the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, did you see this morning's article?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "By this time of year, the list of entries for the autumn Senior campaign was already beginning to take shape."
choice_data_list: You mean your rivals in each race?
You mean the rivals in each of the races, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...No matter who my opponents are,
I intend to seize 1st place.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
However, I have no intention of becoming so conceited
that I underestimate things and overlook information.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
From today on, make sure your training
takes your opponents into account.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To prepare strategies against Narita Brian's rivals, I review the materials I've gathered.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: According to it, Hishi Amazon, who had fierce battles in the Arima Kinen, has announced her entry into the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On race day, we'll likely be competing against
a version of her that has grown even stronger since the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And as for the upcoming Tenno Sho (Autumn)...

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, this next opponent looks like a piece of cake!
It's just that Machikane Tannhauser, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Matikanetannhauser.
In a sense, rumors about her never ceased.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Though possessing the strength to win a GⅠ,
one factor after another has kept victory just out of reach."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "At last year's Arima Kinen, where I thought I could finally compete in perfect condition—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Falling ill right beforehand,
she wasn't even able to run in the race, so they say...

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
If she's the opponent... well,
Narita Brian should have an easy win, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, you're running in the Japan Cup, right?
Then we should prepare for the race against the "Empress"...

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you're so serious.
You gotta know when to slack off a bit, or you'll burn yourself out.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: Besides, people are making a fuss about this "sister showdown," but in reality, the media is piling the expectations meant for your older sister, Biwa Hayahide, onto you—

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, wait!?
Listen to me!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian was already on the training track, having finished warming up.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Trainer. I can go anytime.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian is an Umamusume who always faces running
head-on, with everything she has.
So next time, at the Tenno Sho (Autumn), she surely...
choice_data_list: You're giving the Tenno Sho (Autumn) your all too, right?
You're giving the Tenno Sho (Autumn) your all too, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The only thing that can quench
a parched heart is racing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I have no time to cut corners on anything.
Besides, this is the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
None of our opponents can be overcome easily.
How could we face them with anything less than our all?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hey. What are you freezing up for?
We have no time to stop in our tracks.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Narita Brian and I continued
our training toward the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That evening—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Is this everything?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Brian!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Why are you in casual clothes? Today's a weekday." knots

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, training was
off today. That's why I've been out and about.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Still, you're working hard every single day.
As your older sister, I'm proud of you."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Don't be so formal with me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I plan on surpassing you too.
Be ready for it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...I'm the one who ends up looking at your back.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Brian, run as far ahead as you can.
Just keep sprinting forward without looking back.
